spans.s: पक्तव्य a. to be cooked or baked.

पक्ति॑ f. cooking, food, digestion, ripening (fig. =
bearing consequences), development.

प॑क्ति f. cooking, food, digestion, ripening (fig. = bearing
consequences), development.
पक्तिदृष्टि f. du. digestive organs and sight.
पक्तृ॑ m. who cooks or bakes.
पक्थ॑ m. N. of a man, pl. of a people.
पक्वान्न n. cooked food.
पक्षक (adj. —˚) wing.
पक्षग्रहण n. abstr. to seq.
पक्षग्राह a. choosing a party.
पक्ष˚ग्राहिन् a. choosing a party.
पक्षद्वार (& ˚क*) n. a side- or inner door.

पक्षपात m. moult or flight (lit. the falling or flying
of the wings), partisanship (lit. the falling to one side) predilection
for (loc., gen., प्रति, or —˚).
पक्षपुच्छ॑ n. pl. wings and tail.
पक्ष॑वन्त् a. winged or belonging to a party.
पक्षविकल a. with lamed wings.
प॑क्षस् n. wing, side.

पक्षान्त m. the end of the wings of an army or the last
day of a fortnight.
पक्षिमृगता f. the condition of a bird or of a beast.

पक्षिराज् m. the king of the birds (E. of Garuḍa or
Jatayu).

पक्षि˚राज m. the king of the birds (E. of Garuḍa or
Jatayu).
पक्षिशावक m. young bird, birdling.
पक्षिस्वामिन् m. = पक्षिराज्.
पक्षीन्द्र m. = पक्षिराज्.
पक्षोत्तर s. cover formed by the wings.
प॑क्ष्मन् n. eyelash.

1 पा॑क a. very young, simple, ignorant, stupid, artless,
honest. —m. the young of animals, N. of a Daitya.

2 पाक m. (adj. —˚ f. ई) cooking, baking (tr. & intr.),
burning (bricks), cooking in the stomach, i.e. digestion;
 ripening,
maturity, development (esp. of consequences), perfection.
पाकत्रा॑ adv. simply, artlessly.
पाकपात्र n. cooking-utensil.
पा॑कबलि m. = पाकयज्ञ॑.
पाकभाण्ड n. = पाकपात्र.
पाकयज्ञ॑ m. a simple or domestic sacrifice.
पाकयज्ञिक a. relating to the P. (v. prec.).
पाक˚यज्ञि॑य a. relating to the P. (v. prec.).
पाकल॑ a. quite black.
पाकव॑त् adv. = पाकत्रा॑.
पाकशंस॑ a. speaking honestly.

पाकशासन m. the punisher of Pāka or the instructor
of the ignorant (E. of Indra).
पाकारु॑ m. a cert. disease.

पाकिम a. obtained by cooking or burning (pot etc.),
red-hot.
पाक्य a. cookable or obtained by cooking.
पाक्या॑ f. (instr.) in simplicity or honesty.
पाक्षपातिक a. favouring a party, partial.
पाक्षिक a. = prec. or subject to an alternative.
